Physical pages 97 and 144, (7-25)/(8-12): bit depth 8, valid maximum PCM code 255, expand by two zero low bits. Output is 1020 rather than full-range 1023.
Same PCM reconstruction formula with zero depth difference. Both samples fit 10 bits; left shift by zero leaves 511 and 1023.
PcmBitDepthY must be at most BitDepthY. Coded 9 yields 10 and passes the stated constraint, coded 10 yields 11 and fails before any reconstruction shift.
Physical pages 76, 171–172: B uses both lists and reads override. Its zero value selects defaults clipped to each list size; min(5,2)=2, min(2,4)=2.
For P, list 1 does not cause syntax presence. With one entry in list 0, the override flag is absent and inferred 1; the list-0 minus-one field infers zero. Active counts (1,0).
For B, the four-entry list 1 makes override present. With override 1, only its minus-one value is read; the one-entry list 0 infers zero. Active counts (1,3).
Physical page 55, 5.9.3: using the normative masks m=4, (-6 & 3)−(-6 & 4)=2−0=2. This checks the modular verifier by a different expression.
For m=8, both +8 and −8 have low three bits zero and bit 3 set; the mask formula returns −8 in both directions.
